notes.title: The demo version of my new game is now available!
notes.notes:
I am happy to announce that the demo version of my new game is already available for everyone!
If you like puzzles in a dark atmosphere and the style of classic first-person shooters, then ZERO PROTOCOL is exactly what you are looking for!

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2840250/extras/gif3.gif?t=1713213620

Play the demo and add the game to your wishlist!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2840250/ZERO_PROTOCOL/
